method: Official Google product/help documentation. Source-backed product capability descriptions and original reproducible exercises; no signed-in Gemini UI or model-output quality test was performed.

claims.verified: Official prompting guidance covers task, context and format; the five-field tutorial and activity example are original editorial exercises, not special API syntax.
Web upload and file analysis supported subject to format/account/limit constraints. PDF version comparison and NT$1600 total are author-created exercises with explicit expected results.
Gems web create/edit, Knowledge, preview/save, mobile availability, current Drive file updates, no Live. The article does not claim that local GEMINI.md automatically loads in Gems.

Canvas supports docs/slides/apps/code, autosave, Code and Show console, copy/export; shared app data can be accessible/editable to public-link users; shared content opens on web. Exercises do not claim to be deployed or production-tested.
18+, login, select Deep Research, optional sources, plan edit/start/open, export. Google Search default; Gmail/Drive require connectivity; mobile source selector rolling out.
Mobile Live controls, camera/screenshare and platform-specific notifications; muting mic can leave camera/screenshare active. No universal claim that Chrome Live is unavailable.

Personal activity default 18 months, alternatives 3/36/indefinite; Keep Activity off and temporary chats retained 72h; feedback exception; reviewed data up to 3 years; other services and Spark remote data have separate controls. No account setting changed.

Primary eligibility: 18+, personal account, Pro/Ultra, Keep Activity on; excluded EEA/Nigeria/Switzerland/UK. Taiwan not excluded. Experimental. Some legacy FAQ copy says Ultra only; article transparently resolves to current primary eligibility and dedicated skill/schedule pages.

Schedule create manually/conversationally, Run now, pause/resume, timezone fixed at creation; not suitable for time-critical monitoring. Cloud execution and local-browser availability distinguished; no schedule created.
Create skill manually, upload SKILL.md/root SKILL.md ZIP; no network-dependent scripts; enable/disable on Skills page. CLI skill environment distinguished.
